cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name is on bathroom duty. I taught you to use this mop; it's time you took it without being asked twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You get the floor much cleaner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Flattery has improved since last week. The floor won't. Take the mop and show me what you remember.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you do the first bit so I can copy you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll talk you through it. First, put both hands on the mop. That's it—my teaching works much better when you're holding the equipment.

reason: Make A recognize the pupil evasion and keep its promised lesson verbal so B physically assumes the task rather than returning it through a demonstration request.
